summary.text: LUND ÅS AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2005-12-12. LUND ÅS AS is a company whose registered activity is to invest in real estate or in companies that own real estate, and anything connected therewith. It was previously named JOHAN K. SKANCKESVEI 1-3 AS until 2022-10-29. Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 5 215 832 NOK and the annual result was 1 994 159 NOK; operating income was up from 5 167 663 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 2 004 622 NOK in 2024 to 1 994 159 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 7 529 761 NOK in 2024 to 7 592 052 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-06 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
